jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Patrick - hx's Director of Partnerships and Strategic Development.

 

I joined hx just over a year ago after over 9 years in the insurtech industry. A year in, I am glad to share that the partnerships vertical has cemented itself as one of the strategic pillars that is now foundational to hx's continued growth and success. As we continue our penetration into the North American market, we are now at a point where we need to bring on a Strategic Partnerships Manager based in our NYC office to own key partner relationships, primarily in the consulting/SI space, as well as proactively source our next set of needle-moving strategic relationships to fuel revenue growth.

 

The global team you'd be joining is innovative, efficient, curious and impactful (+ quick-witted). We explore potential partnership growth initiatives with a strict focus and ROI in mind. We are a team of self-starters that thrive when being thrown into the deep end and create measurable success.

 

There is no 'perfect' candidate. Exposure to or experience with partnerships, business development, sales and relationship building in the US P&C market is being prioritized, it is not a hard requirement. hx is a company where the sum of our parts has a massively disproportionate impact than any individual skillset, so if you think you are a team player that does best when driving cross-functional success both internally and externally, we would love to chat!




ABOUT HYPEREXPONENTIAL (HX)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 


ABOUT THE PARTNERSHIPS TEAM

Our partners include global consultancies and systems integrators across the Big Four, MBB and specialist firms, alongside leading technology and data providers.

These relationships help us enter new accounts, support complex customer transformations and build confidence in the wider hx ecosystem. When they work well, partnerships become a force multiplier across our entire commercial organisation.

The team is still relatively young and operates with a broad remit. We work closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, Delivery and Product across joint go-to-market planning, business development, partner enablement and commercial relationships.

As Strategic Partnerships Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of key North American relationships while identifying and developing new opportunities. You’ll be accountable for turning those relationships into measurable outcomes, including partner-influenced pipeline, joint opportunities, stronger delivery capability and long-term strategic value.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own and grow strategic relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, technology companies and data partners across North America.

 - Build joint business plans covering account mapping, pipeline generation, enablement, marketing activity and shared commercial goals.

 - Identify and develop new partners that can expand hx’s reach within the insurance market.

 - Work with Sales teams to identify co-selling opportunities, coordinate account activity and generate partner-led pipeline.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on joint campaigns, events, content and market-facing initiatives.

 - Partner with Solutions, Customer Success and Delivery to ensure partners are equipped to support hx customers effectively.

 - Develop repeatable partner enablement, training, accreditation and certification programmes.

 - Use AI and automation to improve the efficiency and quality of partner research, planning, reporting and engagement.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO HAVE DONE

 - Built and grown strategic partnerships within SaaS, AI, technology, consulting or a similarly complex industry.

 - Managed senior relationships across consultancies, systems integrators, technology providers or other strategic partners.

 - Created joint go-to-market plans and co-selling initiatives that delivered measurable pipeline or revenue.

 - Navigated complex commercial discussions, proposals, contracts and partnership agreements.

 - Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Delivery, Product and Solutions teams to deliver shared outcomes.

 - Used data, commercial tools and AI to prioritise opportunities, improve partner performance and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment.

 


YOU’RE UNLIKELY TO THRIVE HERE IF

 - You prefer maintaining established partner relationships rather than building and developing them.

 - You find it difficult to connect relationship-building activity to clear commercial outcomes.

 - You are reluctant to use AI and new technology to improve how you work.

If reading our Culture Document https://hx.wiki/ leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you will do your best work. We are building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 


COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $157,500 - $175,000

Bonus/Variable: $47,250 - $52,250

The posted range represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation we review the market rate of each candidate which can include a variety of factors including qualifications, experience etc.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

 


BENEFITS

 - $6000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

 - Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs

 - Mental health support via Spring Health and Rula

 - Access to One Medical

 - Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

 - Pet discount plans, retirement plan (401K), and discount programs available to employees

Additional perks

 - Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

 - Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

 - Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at our WeWork https://www.wework.com/en-GB/buildings/500-7th-ave--new-york-city--NY office space.

 - Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Talent Partner Screen 

Hiring Manager Interview 

Skills Assessment 

Values Interview + Meet the CEO

We offer!

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 


NEXT STEPS

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.



Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Her responsibilities mainly include boosting morale, appearing on calls and avoiding anything that looks like account admin.

Customer Success at hx is about much more than account management. We work with some of the world’s largest insurers to make sure hx is driving real outcomes across pricing, underwriting and portfolio strategy.

Our Global Customer Success team is currently eight people, and we’re looking for someone to join us as we continue to grow. You’ll work closely with some of our largest and most complex customers, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, driving adoption, managing renewals and turning customer insight into better product, delivery and commercial decisions.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys complex enterprise relationships, wants real ownership and is excited to help shape how Customer Success continues to scale at hx.

Sounds interesting? Read more about us below.

As we scale, you’ll join a high-performing group that thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and impact. Your work will directly strengthen customer outcomes, account health, and hx’s market reputation.

 - Delivered measurable value and adoption outcomes for enterprise SaaS customers, ideally within insurance, fintech, or complex B2B environments.

 - Managed account health and renewals, achieving strong net revenue retention and identifying expansion opportunities in a high-growth setting.

 - Led high-impact customer engagements (QBRs, workshops, value assessments) that resulted in increased product adoption and customer satisfaction.

 - Captured and synthesised structured customer feedback, influencing product or operational improvements at scale.

 - Collaborated effectively with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to drive customer success and resolve complex challenges.

 - Demonstrated resilience, adaptability, and proactive ownership in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, consistently prioritising actions for business impact.

jobs.title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx.

I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies.

Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work.

We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business.

Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below.




ABOUT HYPEREXPONENTIAL (HX)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.





ABOUT THE PEOPLE TEAM

Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.

Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.

You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side.

 - Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

 - Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves.

 - Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort.

 - Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person.

 - Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE DONE

 - Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project.

 - Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you.

 - Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for.

 - Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend.

 - Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role.

 - Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information.

 - Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues.




YOU'RE UNLIKELY TO THRIVE HERE IF

 - You struggle to adapt to change or ambiguity, or find it difficult to collaborate across diverse teams.

 - You're not energised by a culture that values ownership, feedback, and continuous learning.

If reading our Culture Document https://hx.wiki/ leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.




COMPENSATION

This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.




BENEFITS

 - £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

 - 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

 - Company pension scheme via Penfold.

 - Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life http://Spectrum.life.
